I've done this with RPG Maker XP! But it was still a fantasy setting.
What's nice was keeping a "master" map with small sections to make it easier to throw together maps quickly! I even added small borders to most tiles so that the maps were still grid based.
Have fun!

As mentioned above, it would help if you told us what you'd already looked at, if you have any specific styles you're looking for, etc. The
pinned request form
is a good start.
That said, as mentioned there's the MV resources section of this forum.
There's the DLC shop linked to on the top of each page which has numerous options for both of those themes by a variety of authors if you browse by Tilesets.
Kokoro Reflections has a pretty large assortment of both modern and cyberpunk tilesets.
